requires_external_validation.scope: On one NH4SCN specimen at fixed cold temperature/stress, vary only residence time before export/isolation. Measure contact area, force/displacement, gross retreat, exported inventory, precipitation everywhere, calorimetric heat and pump/actuator work; perform warm regrowth and measure restored geometry/composition/solvent. Include exposed-face, zero-stress and inert mechanical controls. Reject if warm-regrowth composition threshold or positive complete cold heat fails.
